significant_events.title: Mali: Junta forces retake strategic town of Kidal
significant_events.summary: Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies. The Tuareg separatist Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) said in a statement it had "decided to carry out a strategic and controlled withdrawal of its forces from the town of Kidal." It said the withdrawal took place without direct fighting.

Mali.title: In Mali, the takeover of Kidal "consolidates" the Transition
Mali.summary: In Mali, the army and its Russian partners of the Africa Corps reinvested Tuesday, October 6, the city of Kidal, in the north of the country, less than six months after being driven out by the separatists of the Fla and their jihadist allies of the Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda. This prestigious victory was achieved without even having to fight, as the armed groups withdrew before the arrival of the army .

Mali.title: Mali: after the takeover of Kidal, the challenges facing the Malian army
Mali.summary: Kidal comes back under the control of the Malian army for the second time in less than three years. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) entered this city in northern Mali on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, five months and eleven days after it was taken, on April 25, by the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) Allied with the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (Jnim), the independence movement had snatched it from Bamako less than three years after the first resumption of November 2023.

Mali.title: FAMa enter Kidal after Fla withdrawal
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces entered Kidal on Tuesday, October 6, five months after leaving the city. In a statement read on national television, government spokesman Brigadier General Issa Ousmane Coulibaly announced that national forces had regained control of this northern regional capital According to the government, the operation mobilized ground and air assets with the support of Russian partners.

Mali.title: "Kidal is and will remain Malian": Choguel Kokalla Maïga's strong tribute to the memory of General Sadio Camara and the bravery of the FAMa
Mali.summary: Message from former Prime Minister Choguel Kokalla MAÏGA, following the consolidation of the military assets of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) in Kidal As part of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their Russian partners have launched, since last weekend, a major air-land operation in the Kidal region Five months after the treacherous terrorist attacks of April 25, 2026, which took the life of General Sadio Camara, Minister of State, Minister of Defense and Veterans Affairs, these operations aimed to track down and neutralize the remnants of terrorist armed groups operating throughout the…

Mali.title: Kidal: The end of recess ​The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their foreign partners, signed their return to the city of Kidal yesterday. The large-scale air-land operations they initiated made it possible to track down and neutralize the terrorist groups that were sowing disorder and desolation in the locality.
Mali.summary: FAMa elements operating in the locality In the wake of this overwhelming victory, the General Staff of the Armed Forces invites the people of Kidal to calm down, to be vigilant and to continue their precious collaboration with the Defence and Security Forces. Large-scale operations have been carried out for a few days in the Kidal Region Determined to regain control of this strategic city, the Malian Army has launched an unprecedented offensive aimed at putting pressure on the armed terrorist groups operating in the region.

Mali.title: Mali Army Retakes Kidal With Russian Support
Mali.summary: Mali's army, backed by Russian paramilitary forces, has retaken the northern town of Kidal after Tuareg separatists announced a "strategic and controlled withdrawal" from the area. The Azawad Liberation Front said its forces withdrew without direct fighting, attributing the move to what it described as the disproportionate use of air power by Russia's Africa Corps.

Mali.title: Mali: Junta Forces Retake Strategic Town of Kidal
Mali.summary: Mali's military regained control of the strategic town of Kidal after forcing Tuareg separatists and al-Qaeda-linked jihadists to withdraw following an offensive backed by Russia's Africa Corps. Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies.

Mali.title: The Malian army has regained possession of Kidal
Mali.summary: After airstrikes in recent days in the Kidal region, an impressive land convoy from Gao, then Anefis, entered the Tuareg rebel stronghold on Tuesday afternoon, without encountering resistance. The Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), which had held the city since April 26, withdrew in front of the advance of the column .

Mali.title: Mali: in Kidal, "the army recovered territory, it did not beat its opponent"
Mali.summary: In Mali, the junta of General Goïta managed yesterday Tuesday to recapture the city of Kidal, which it had lost six months ago to the Tuareg rebels of the Fla, the Azawad Liberation Front. The Malian Armed Forces and their Russian allies entered the large city in the far north of the country without a fight yesterday afternoon. Is this the end of the war?

Mali.title: Mali: Junta forces retake strategic town of Kidal
Mali.summary: Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies. The Tuareg separatist Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) said in a statement it had "decided to carry out a strategic and controlled withdrawal of its forces from the town of Kidal." It said the withdrawal took place without direct fighting.

Mali.title: Kidal: the Malian army regains control of the city
Mali.summary: The Malian army regained control of Kidal, in northern Mali, on Tuesday, October 6. The Malian Armed Forces entered the city without resistance. This return comes more than five months after the capture of Kidal by the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), allied to the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM) Several security sources confirm this entry of the Fama into Kidal.

Mali.title: Mali’s army says it has taken Kidal from Tuareg rebels, with Russia’s help
Mali.summary: Mali’s armed forces have entered the strategic northern city of Kidal, five months after separatist rebels seized it, following an air and ground campaign backed by Russia’s Africa Corps. In a statement carried by state television on Tuesday, Mali’s transitional government said troops had “consolidated their positions” in the city, “supported by their Russian partners”.

Burkina Faso.title: Maternal mortality, nutrition, HPV: when professional advocacy starts to change practices
Burkina Faso.summary: Maternal mortality, nutrition, HPV: when professional advocacy begins to change Carbetocin practices against postpartum hemorrhage in Burkina Faso, micronutrients and midwifery recruitment in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), papillomavirus vaccination in Senegal . For almost four years, the advocacy of six associations of health professionals has started to produce concrete changes in these three countries.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: the national gendarmerie in search of Boureima Sanfo
Burkina Faso.summary: The Burkinabe national gendarmerie is looking for Boureima Sanfo, a 51-year-old trader in Hamelé in the province of Ioba, in the southwestern part of Burkina Faso, for acts of "breach of trust", according to a notice launched on Wednesday, October 7, 2026. The trader Boureima Sanfo is wanted by the national gendarmerie for "breach of trust relating to the sum of more than 40,000,000 CFA francs" .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso
Burkina Faso.summary: Human rights violations and abuses against civilians continued during the armed conflict. Military authorities continued their crackdown on the rights to freedom of expression, association and press freedom, through the arrest of journalists, the suspension of media, enforced disappearances and suspensions of NGOs.
